title: $\mathrm {U}_{q\tilde q}\mathfrak{sl}(2;\mathbb R)$ Turaev-Viro invariants for cusped $3$-manifolds
summary: We define a family of Turaev-Viro type invariants for hyperbolic $3$-manifolds with cusp ends, extending the invariants introduced in \cite{LMSWY} for hyperbolic $3$-manifolds with totally geodesic boundary. These invariants are constructed from what we call the ideal $\mathrm{U}_{q\tilde q}\mathfrak{sl}(2;\mathbb R)$-$6j$ symbols, which are variants of the $6j$-symbols associated with the positive representations of the modular double of $\mathrm{U}_q\mathfrak{sl}(2;\mathbb R)$.
